MOST IMMEDIATE

No.55/1/1/91-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)

New Delhi, the 21st February, 1991
2 Phalguna, 1912(S)

The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from 20th February, 1991 -

(i) Shri Vidya Charan Shukla has relinquished the office of the Minister of External Affairs.

(ii) Shri Shakeelur Rehman has relinquished the office of the Minister of Health & Family Welfare.

(iii) Shri Basavaraj Patil has relinquished the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Steel and Mines.

(iv) Shri Bhagey Gobardhan has relinquished the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Human Resource Development.

(v) Shri Sarwar Hussain has relinquished the office of the Minister of State in the Ministry of Food and Civil Supplies.

To

All Members of the Council of Ministers.

-----

Copy forwarded to Deputy Chairman and all members of the Planning Commission for information.

-----

Copy forwarded for information to:-

Secretary to the Prime Minister.
Special Secretary to the Prime Minister.
Additional Secretary to the Prime Minister.

-----

Copy also forwarded to:-

Secretary to the President.
Secretary to the Vice-President.

(V.R. Srinivasan)
Deputy Secretary to the Cabinet.

-----

3rd Capon
